title: Safety and Efficacy of ActiGraft Treatment in Wound Care in Medical Centers
official: An Observational Clinical Registry to Collect Safety and Efficacy Data on Wound Care in Medical Centers
summary: Multicenter observational study to explore the efficacy of ActiGraft in the treatment of exuding cutaneous wounds in real-life usage.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject is ≥18 years of age
* Subject has an exuding cutaneous wound
* Subject agrees to the use of his health data, including photos of his wound in analysis and publications
* Subject/LAR must be able to read and understand English and/or Spanish

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subject/LAR is unable to read and understand English or Spanish.
